textes.Bienvenue au laboratoire Hélix, un labor: Welcome to the Hélix lab, a research laboratory. Researchers, projects, experiments, samples, results and publications: the data of its six teams is all here. You help the staff: Véronique, the director, Mathis at the office, Clémence on scheduling, Rose at the storeroom, Gaspard on quality and Patrice on finance. Explore the database to solve the missions.

textes.Le laboratoire Hélix est un laboratoire: The Hélix lab is a research laboratory with six teams. Each team runs its own projects, each with a budget, a start date and an end date. The end date is only recorded when the project stops: as long as it’s in progress, the cell stays empty. Véronique, the director, is preparing the steering committee. She wants to review the projects still in progress, with their start date and the money allocated to them.
